subject: EdgeCloud: Azure co-sell badge submission and technical validation plan
messages:
From: Daniel Kim <daniel@edgecloud.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liza Park <liza.park@edgecloud.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Azure co-sell badge — submission + ask

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Per our discussion, attaching our initial evidence pack and the marketplace listing draft. Can you confirm the minimal set Redwood needs to validate for an Azure co-sell badge and an approximate timeline to complete technical validation? Specifically:

- Customer demo recording + test tenant access (we can spin up a demo environment)
- Integration architecture diagram
- SSO / SCIM screenshots and sample SAML response
- Telemetry & logging evidence (sample logs or export)

We'd like to target a co-sell-ready badge by mid-Oct if possible. Do you need anything from procurement up front (PO/contract) to start the certification queue?

Attachments: evidence_matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 58KB); marketplace_listing_v1.md (md, 12KB)

Cheers,
Daniel Kim
Head of Partnerships
EdgeCloud AI

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel@edgecloud.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell badge — submission + ask

Hi Daniel — thanks, received the pack and the listing draft. Quick acknowledgement and next steps from our side: 

1) I'll own coordination with Azure and run the evidence checklist. I've attached a short Redwood checklist (redwood_ask_list.pdf) that maps what we need for technical validation vs what legal/procurement will require.

2) Olga — can you triage the evidence_matrix.xlsx and call out any gaps for tenant access, telemetry samples, and SSO test cases?

3) Connor — once we have the final listing copy + pricing, can you start a co-sell term review? Procurement contact included should be fine but we usually route an MSA first.

Proposed timeline:
- 09/30: Redwood technical gap list back to EdgeCloud
- 10/06: Test tenant & demo recording delivered by EdgeCloud
- 10/08–10/12: Redwood runs validation and prepares submission to Azure
- Target: 10/16 co-sell submission

If any of that is unrealistic on your side, tell us which dates to move. Looping Olga and Connor now.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
[email signature]

[Attachment: redwood_ask_list.pdf (pdf, 18KB)]

Subject: Re: Azure co-sell badge — technical gaps + access ask

Hi — I reviewed evidence_matrix.xlsx and flagged a few items in the attached sheet. High-level asks: 

- Test tenant with a service account that has admin-level access (we'll need to run an end-to-end ingest and trace a request)
- Sample logs containing request IDs and trace spans (redacted PII is fine)
- SSO test account and sample SAML response (we need metadata/xml and an IdP test user)
- Clarify model hosting architecture: are you using a managed inference endpoint or self-hosted infra on Azure?

If you can provide the tenant by 10/06 we should be able to complete the validation window on 10/08–10/12 as Priya outlined. Also attaching a short runbook for the test steps I will execute.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: technical_runbook.md (md, 6KB)]

Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EdgeCloud co-sell — commercial & contracting note

Priya / Daniel — quick note from legal/procurement review side. We generally need: 

- A signed MSA (or confirmation you'll accept Redwood's standard enterprise annex) before co-sell commitments are finalized.
- Confirmation of billing / reseller flow (who invoices customers for consumption on Azure Marketplace?)
- Any SKU/commitment pricing that will be exposed in the listing (we need final numbers to validate revshare and entitlements)

I've attached a draft co-sell terms doc with the clauses we typically include. If EdgeCloud prefers to use your MSA, please share and we'll run it through our template for redlines. Also propose we use DocuSign for the signatures — I dropped a placeholder link below for the co-sell annex.

Connor O'Brien
Head of Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
